source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check setting shared port as DHCP for ipv4 is normal.
1. Plug network cable on shared  and chcek the link status
2. Power on system and boot into BIOS setup
3. Goto "server mgmt" page to check BMC ip
4. Check the ip source is on DHCP mode
5. Use this to login BMC Web

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Check the ip can be present on BIOS
2. Check the Web can be login
3. DHCP or Static IP should display correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Set shared port as DHCP(IPv4) (Shared - NC-SI as DHCP IPv4): agent reads the BMC LAN source/address with ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address|Subnet|DHCP|Source" (or Redfish EthernetInterface read via curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" "https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/1/EthernetInterfaces" 2>&1); setting the DHCP mode itself is done in BMC/BIOS UI by the operator.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the lan-print/Redfish IPv4 address-source output so the user confirms the Shared - NC-SI port is on DHCP(IPv4) and the IP is present; the mode change + web-login are operator/UI steps.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: enabling DHCP may drop the operator's static management IP; confirm the console path before toggling.

original_test_intent: Verify the BMC's shared NC-SI path can use IPv4 DHCP, shows the assigned address and DHCP source correctly in BIOS, supports BMC WebUI login and leaves the host-facing shared network healthy.
original_method: An engineer connects the shared cable, boots to BIOS, confirms DHCP mode and the assigned BMC IPv4, then performs a BMC WebUI login while the shared host link is monitored for disruption.
manual_activity: The shared cable operation, BIOS DHCP/address/source inspection and BMC WebUI login are core human acceptance steps. The agent may monitor NC-SI and host network state but cannot replace those observations.
required_inputs: NC-SI controller/channel, shared connector, host interface and MAC mapping
DHCP server, VLAN, lease policy/reservation and new-IP discovery
Expected BIOS source/address display and BMC credentials
Host-network maintenance approval, prior settings and independent console recovery
safety_requirements: Do not switch an unmapped NC-SI channel or unplug active shared host traffic.
Verify DHCP reachability and a tested console recovery path before losing the current address.
Protect credentials and lease data; do not attach to an unapproved network.
Stop on no lease, duplicate IP, host disruption or management loss; preserve evidence and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Capture mapped BMC source/address/MAC plus host-interface/link/route state before and after the operator sequence.
Correlate the DHCP lease with the BMC MAC and operator BIOS/WebUI evidence.
Monitor host-network health and report observations separately from the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the shared-NC-SI DHCP transition and host-impact window.
Perform physical cabling, BIOS DHCP/address inspection and WebUI login.
Validate the displayed source and host health and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Readback only. It must not assume channel 1/fixed Redfish instances, and inline passwords/TLS bypass are not safe defaults. It also omits host-side NC-SI impact.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the mapped vendor-supported BMC endpoint with protected credentials, retain complete DHCP/source/MAC output and pair it with stable host interface telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Shared cable, IPv4 DHCP, BIOS display, WebUI login, DHCP/Static source correctness and 5/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN HUMAN BIOS/WEBUI METHOD WITH NCSI CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Archive both BMC and host shared-path state, validate DHCP lease discovery and console recovery, have the engineer perform the UI flow, then correlate lease-to-MAC, BMC readback and host link/route health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NC-SI path and approved IPv4 management/host network.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/BIOS/NIC firmware, host driver, API/tool and DHCP service revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform NC-SI/BMC guide and project DHCP/network plan.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds host-impact monitoring, stable mapping and recovery without replacing BIOS/WebUI acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; DHCP readback alone is not accepted as UI or shared-path coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: NC-SI mapping, DHCP scope/discovery and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The same physical link can remain up while the BMC lease or host path is incorrect.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies DHCP and host-impact parameters and may approve retaining or restoring DHCP. Missing values are readiness inputs, not permanent BLOCKED. API-only validation omits explicit BIOS and WebUI coverage.
expected_evidence: NC-SI/shared-port mapping, pre-change state and approved DHCP/rollback plan
Lease-to-BMC-MAC proof and BIOS showing DHCP source/address
Authenticated BMC WebUI login at the assigned IPv4
Host/BMC final health, error review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently describes IPv4 DHCP on the shared NC-SI management path, with BIOS display and WebUI verification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workflow is clear. Site DHCP and topology inputs control readiness but are not permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain readback and lockout warning, but reject PARTIAL under the manual UI rule and add shared-host risk.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its NC-SI/DHCP/recovery analysis while reclassifying the explicit BIOS/WebUI core as MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds lease-to-MAC and host-side health evidence while separating tool result and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an unrelated DHCP lease or unchanged host link from being mistaken for successful BMC NC-SI DHCP operation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The agent can automate readback and host monitoring, but the source accepts BIOS presentation and a WebUI login performed after physical shared-port setup. These human core checks make the case MANUAL ONLY under V3.1.
